nodes.label: ROUTEMAP.md — module index
nodes.rationale: Compact codebase map so a fresh chat loads only the files a task needs instead of scanning src/; line counts flag context cost.

nodes.label: Static PWA on GitHub Pages (no backend)
nodes.rationale: With no server, cross-device sync is a snapshot pushed to a private GitHub repo via the user's PAT and AI is Gemini free tier with a device-local BYO key; deploy = git push origin main → Actions → Pages. The same codebase also ships as a sideloaded Capacitor 8 Android app.

nodes.label: Task → files table
nodes.rationale: Maps each task area (schema, scoring, active workout, past workouts, equipment, diet, food DBs, AI, sync, charts, settings, Android shell, notifications, native rest timer, Android build) to the minimal file set to load.

nodes.label: App shell & routing
nodes.rationale: main.tsx mounts App (Android: initNativeEarly before the first render); App.tsx owns the HashRouter and all routes and on launch runs ensureSeeded, runDailyChecksOnce, catch-up achievements/quests and sync, plus a gated initNative + lazy NativeShell on Android. routes.ts TAB_ROUTES/KNOWN_ROUTES are shared by TabBar, the back handler and deep links.

nodes.label: Data model & persistence
nodes.rationale: types.ts holds every interface (Id = number|string); Dexie GymDB (version 7) adds a sync middleware (UUID ids, updatedAt stamp, dirty flag) and onDataReplaced/emitDataReplaced for wholesale replaces; backup.ts TABLES is the serialization allow-list; merge.ts merges snapshots updatedAt-wins.

nodes.label: GitHub snapshot sync (private repo via PAT)
nodes.rationale: buildPayload serializes only TABLES; withSyncLock runs work on the sync chain without overlapping a pull; installSyncTriggers pushes dirty data on an 8 s debounce and its visibilitychange sync also covers Android resume.

nodes.label: Workout subsystem
nodes.rationale: Live session logging, templates, past-workout calendar/editing, double progression, plates, scoring, season lifecycle and strength standards.

nodes.label: Diet & nutrition subsystem
nodes.rationale: nutrition.ts logFood is the single write path; foodProviders.ts orchestrates OFF + USDA search and the barcode chain; BarcodeScanSheet uses ML Kit on Android with a zxing fallback.

nodes.label: AI layer (Gemini free tier, device-local BYO key)
nodes.rationale: Shared Gemini client built around generateStructured, aiStore holding key/model in localStorage, and the generic AiReportCard state machine.

nodes.label: AI workout coach + opening-weight suggestions
nodes.rationale: Post-workout coach note is auto-generated and cached by sessionId; pre-workout AI weights fire once per session via useWorkoutPlan with a silent offline fallback.

nodes.label: AI diet coach + macro-completion / food-swap
nodes.rationale: Diet report is generated manually and cached by date; 'complete your macros' suggestions offer tap-to-Add; EntryEditor offers an AI swap.

nodes.label: Gamification & progress modules
nodes.rationale: Achievements and weekly quests are add-only; ProgressScreen shows e1RM trends, PR wall and muscle volume with self-hosted SVG chart primitives (no CDN).

nodes.label: Build stamp (__APP_VERSION__, __BUILD_SHA__, __BUILD_TIME__)
nodes.rationale: vite.config.ts defines the app version from package.json, the build SHA from GITHUB_SHA or local git, and the build time; typed in vite-env.d.ts and shown by the Settings VersionFooter with the Dexie schema version and, on Android, versionName/versionCode.

nodes.label: Native (Android / Capacitor) module group
nodes.rationale: All native code lives in src/native/ (plus Java plugins under android/) and is reachable only through isNative; the pure planner/prefs/store libs stay in src/lib/ so they are unit-testable.

nodes.label: Android shell: back button, keep-awake, haptics
nodes.rationale: NativeShell is a router companion: hardware back via the pure backAction plus the backStack LIFO of open sheets, pending notification-tap routes sanitized against ALLOWED_ROUTES, and keep-awake only while a session is active and on /workout/session or resting.

nodes.label: Android reminder engine (notifications)
nodes.rationale: Pure notifyPlanner plans one-shot reminders from a single read-only gatherPlannerData transaction; notifications.ts resyncNow (plan → diff/full → schedule → shade cleanup) runs through a debounced single-flight requestResync; prefs live in the gymtracker-notify zustand store.

nodes.label: Native rest timer bridge
nodes.rationale: restTimerBridge syncs the zustand store rest state with the Java RestTimer plugin via pure reconcileDecision/bridgeAction, a serial queue and re-arm on resume; RestTimerController owns the exact end alarm, countdown and 'Rest over' notifications, and RestTimerReceiver handles Skip/+15 s with the process dead.

nodes.label: Vitest unit-test suite (~326 tests)
nodes.rationale: Tests sit next to their module, run in vitest's node environment without jsdom and with TZ=Europe/Rome; pure functions plus fake-indexeddb; nativeBoundary.test enforces invariant 14.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP Invariants (cross-cutting rules)
nodes.rationale: 18 rules to read before any schema, sync, scoring or AI change; 14–18 cover the Android/Capacitor build.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP maintenance rule (one line per module)
nodes.rationale: Adding, renaming or removing a module, or changing an invariant, must update the matching row and the Task→files table; a subsystem past ~8 files gets its own section.

nodes.label: Invariant 1: backup.ts TABLES is the sync allow-list
nodes.rationale: A table syncs iff it is listed in TABLES (mirrored in merge.ts SnapshotTables); device-local AI caches (coachNotes, dietNotes, workoutSuggestions, dietSuggestions) are deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: Invariant 2: AI cache writes use withSyncTrackingSuspended
nodes.rationale: AI cache rows use natural keys (not in UUID_TABLES) and must not mark data dirty; real user-data writes must not be suspended.

nodes.label: Invariant 3: secrets and device-local prefs never touch Dexie
nodes.rationale: The Gemini key, the GitHub PAT and device-local prefs (notifications, haptics, rest-alert mode) live in zustand-persist localStorage stores (gymtracker-ai, gymtracker-sync, gymtracker-notify), so they are never synced or backed up.

nodes.label: Invariant 4: thinkingBudget=0 on every structured Gemini call
nodes.rationale: Gemini Flash otherwise truncates the JSON output; new generators go through generateStructured<T>.

nodes.label: Invariant 5: finishSession is non-idempotent — re-score with rescoreSession
nodes.rationale: finishSession adds a scoreEvent, full points and bumps the streak; rescoreSession updates the existing event, applies only the points delta and carries the streak.

nodes.label: Invariant 6: equipment separation is by exerciseId
nodes.rationale: Variants are distinct exercises and there is no SetRow.equipment; every weight/PR/progression path already partitions by exerciseId.

nodes.label: Invariant 7: food dedup key offId = barcode ?? source:sourceId
nodes.rationale: OFF stays a bare EAN for backward compatibility, USDA branded reuses the EAN and whole foods use usda:<fdcId>.

nodes.label: Invariant 8: additive Dexie schema + deterministic seed ids
nodes.rationale: Bump version(N) with only new stores and never edit a released version block; seed ids are deterministic (i+1) so two fresh installs merge without duplicating the catalog.

nodes.label: Invariant 9: propagating deletes use tombstones
nodes.rationale: Deletes that must reach other devices use deleteWithTombstone/tombstoneKeys; device-local cache deletes use a plain suspended delete().

nodes.label: Invariant 10: HashRouter + parseRouteId; order by date, not id
nodes.rationale: Ids may be numbers or UUID strings, so route ids are parsed with parseRouteId (never Number()) and queries order by date/startedAt because UUIDs do not sort chronologically.

nodes.label: Invariant 11: report mode (?report=1) skips side-effects
nodes.rationale: Viewing an old session must skip checkAchievements, evaluateQuests, confetti and rank-up.

nodes.label: Invariant 12: Env/CI rules (Node 18 floor / CI Node 22; Android Node ≥ 22 + JDK 21; exact Capacitor pins; no CDN)
nodes.rationale: The PWA builds on Node 18+, Android tooling needs Node ≥ 22 (@capacitor/cli 8.5.2) and JDK 21 with javac; Capacitor packages are pinned exactly so the committed android/ matches; workbox-build 7.1.1 override; zxing wasm and fonts are bundled; the USDA key is inlined only because it is a free per-IP-rate-limited key.

nodes.label: Invariant 13: every screen fits 360px and 320px widths
nodes.rationale: Galaxy S25 is 360px wide: two+ NumberSteppers in a row use compact='narrow' + flex-wrap, chips get whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0, fixed widths in a row sum under ~290px; on Android setTextZoom(100) keeps these rules independent of the One UI font size.

nodes.label: Invariant 14: Native/PWA split (plugins only in src/native/)
nodes.rationale: Outside src/native/ code may statically import only platform.ts and haptics.ts; everything else is a dynamic import()/React.lazy gated on isNative, which is compile-time false in the Pages build so Rollup drops the native chunks. Enforced by nativeBoundary.test.ts and check-pwa-dist.mjs; dist-android/ is never deployed.

nodes.label: Invariant 15: Android identity is permanent
nodes.rationale: appId io.github.monniale.gymtracker, WebView origin https://localhost (never set server/hostname/androidScheme) and the release key in ~/.android-keys/gymtracker/ never change, or the phone's data is orphaned or wiped; debug builds must never connect to the real sync repo.

nodes.label: Invariant 16: notification id scheme
nodes.rationale: LocalNotifications ids = cat*10_000_000 + dayIdx*100 + slot (dayIdx from 2026-01-01), planner cats 10–18, 99 = test; RestTimer owns ids 4201/4202 and request codes 4211–4215 outside LN; never removeAllDeliveredNotifications() because it also kills the rest countdown.

nodes.label: Invariant 17: notification channels are immutable (_vN ids)
nodes.rationale: Android channels cannot change sound/importance/vibration after creation, so the id is bumped and the old one deleted (OBSOLETE_CHANNELS for reminders, RestTimerController.ensureChannels for rest), updating the ids mirrored in notifyHealth.ts and smoke.sh.

nodes.label: Invariant 18: LocalNotifications discipline
nodes.rationale: Only one-shot schedule.at with allowWhileIdle and an explicit isExactNotification; never repeating schedules, never schedule() without granted+enabled notifications, never a time ≤ now + 30 s (LEAD_MS), never cancel with an empty list; taps only navigate to whitelisted routes and never write data or call finishSession.

hyperedges.label: Native/PWA boundary enforcement (isNative gate + boundary test + dist check)
Reminder resync pipeline (gather → plan → diff → schedule → cleanup)
